categories.title: Expense categories
categories.intro: Your business starts with 18 categories. Add your own or deactivate the ones you don't use: a deactivated category is no longer offered when recording expenses, but keeps its history.

form.name: Name
form.codeHint: The code is generated from the name and does not change afterwards.

delete.title: Delete “{{name}}”
delete.body: The category is deleted and cannot be recovered. If it already has expenses on record it cannot be deleted: deactivate it instead.

list.title: Expenses
list.empty: There are no expenses with these filters.

detail.title: Expense {{folio}}
detail.fromShift: Came out of a cash shift drawer

pay.title: Mark “{{folio}}” as paid
pay.body: The expense is paid in full, with the method and today's date. After this the amount is no longer editable: if there is a mistake, cancel it and record it again.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel “{{folio}}”
cancelDialog.body: The expense stops counting in the totals and in the shift's cash count. Write the reason: it stays in the history.

form.beneficiaryHint: If it isn't a supplier from the catalog: the person or place that was paid.
form.amountHint: What the receipt says, before the discount.
form.cashboxHint: An expense paid from the drawer is subtracted from the expected cash when that shift closes.
form.paidImmutable: This expense is already paid: the amount, discount and tax cannot be edited.

errors.amount: Enter a valid amount greater than zero.
